---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: ['enhancement', 'triage']
assignees: ''
---

## 🎵 Feature Summary
Brief description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 🎯 Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? What is the current limitation?

## 💡 Proposed Solution
Describe your proposed solution and how it would work.

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions
Have you considered any alternative approaches?

## 📊 Use Cases
Describe specific use cases where this feature would be valuable:
1. Use case 1
2. Use case 2
3. Use case 3

## 🎼 Implementation Ideas
Any technical details or implementation suggestions:
- API changes needed
- OSC commands required
- UI considerations

## 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request.

## ✅ Acceptance Criteria
What would indicate this feature is complete?
- [ ] Criteria 1
- [ ] Criteria 2
- [ ] Criteria 3

## 📅 Priority
How important is this feature to you?
- [ ] Nice to have
- [ ] Should have
- [ ] Must have
